cd /app && cat > plot.py <<'EOF'
import re, matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

x=y=z=0.0; e=0.0; abs_e=False; rel=False
obj=None
segs=[]
zs=set()
for line in open('text.gcode'):
    l=line.split(';')[0].strip()
    if not l: continue
    if l.startswith('M486'):
        m=re.search(r'S(-?\d+)',l)
        if m: obj=int(m.group(1))
        continue
    if l.startswith('M83'): abs_e=False; continue
    if l.startswith('M82'): abs_e=True; continue
    if l.startswith('G90'): rel=False; continue
    if l.startswith('G91'): rel=True; continue
    if l.startswith('G92'):
        for k,v in re.findall(r'([XYZE])(-?[\d.]+)',l):
            if k=='E': e=float(v)
        continue
    m=re.match(r'G[01]\b',l)
    if not m: continue
    d=dict((k,float(v)) for k,v in re.findall(r'([XYZE])(-?[\d.]+)',l))
    nx=d.get('X',x); ny=d.get('Y',y); nz=d.get('Z',z)
    de=0
    if 'E' in d:
        de = d['E']-e if abs_e else d['E']
        e = d['E'] if abs_e else e+d['E']
    if de>0 and (nx!=x or ny!=y):
        segs.append((x,y,nx,ny,z,obj))
        zs.add(round(z,3))
    x,y,z=nx,ny,nz
print(sorted(zs))
o0=[s for s in segs if s[5]==0]
print(len(segs),len(o0))
import collections
c=collections.Counter(round(s[4],3) for s in o0)
print(sorted(c.items()))
EOF
python3 plot.py

cd /app && cat > z.py <<'EOF'
import numpy as np,matplotlib;matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
exec(open('plot.py').read().split('def draw')[0])
o0=[s for s in segs if s[5]==0]
P=np.array([[s[0],s[1]] for s in o0]+[[s[2],s[3]] for s in o0])
c=P.mean(0);Q=P-c
u,sv,vt=np.linalg.svd(Q,full_matrices=False)
a=np.arctan2(vt[0,1],vt[0,0])
R=np.array([[np.cos(-a),-np.sin(-a)],[np.sin(-a),np.cos(-a)]])
A=np.array([[s[0],s[1]] for s in o0]);B=np.array([[s[2],s[3]] for s in o0])
A=(A-c)@R.T;B=(B-c)@R.T
xmin,xmax=A[:,0].min(),A[:,0].max()
for i,(lo,hi) in enumerate([(xmin,xmin+(xmax-xmin)/2),(xmin+(xmax-xmin)/2,xmax)]):
    m=(A[:,0]>=lo-2)&(A[:,0]<=hi+2)
    fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(24,6))
    ax.plot(np.c_[A[m,0],B[m,0]].T,np.c_[A[m,1],B[m,1]].T,'k-',lw=0.4)
    ax.set_aspect('equal');ax.axis('off')
    fig.savefig(f'zoom{i}.png',dpi=100,bbox_inches='tight');plt.close(fig)
EOF
